lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits. Blobs are aligned in roughly horizontal rows that follow the longitudinal axes of the carinae and vertical columns corresponding to transverse bands.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal carinae, with high-intensity blobs centered at these intersection nodes, forming a structural lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient featuring specular highlights on the upper boundary and deep shadow on the lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately six high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily concentrated in the posterior and dorsal sections of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance points is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
